title: The naive cotangent complex of a symmetric algebra; its differentials are M tensor C
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $0\to K\to A^{\oplus m}\xrightarrow{\ \pi\ }M\to0$ an exact sequence of $A$-modules; write $e_1,\dots,e_m$ for the standard basis of $A^{\oplus m}$ and $m_j=\pi(e_j)$. Let $C=\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ with $\iota_M:M\to C$ [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property], and let $\alpha:A[y_1,\dots,y_m]\to C$ be the surjective homomorphism of $A$-algebras with $\alpha(y_j)=\iota_M(m_j)$, with kernel $J$. Then the $C$-linear map $K\otimes_AC\to J/J^2$, $(\sum_jk_je_j)\otimes c\mapsto c\cdot(\sum_jk_jy_j\bmod J^2)$ (well defined since $\sum_jk_jy_j\in J$ for $\sum_jk_je_j\in K$), is an isomorphism; under it and the basis $\mathrm dy_1,\dots,\mathrm dy_m$ of $\Omega_{A[y]/A}$ [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-kahler-basis], the naive cotangent complex $J/J^2\to\Omega_{A[y]/A}\otimes_{A[y]}C$, $u\bmod J^2\mapsto\mathrm du\otimes1$, of the presentation $\alpha$ becomes the map $K\otimes_AC\to\bigoplus_{j=1}^mC\,\mathrm dy_j$, $(\sum_jk_je_j)\otimes c\mapsto\sum_jck_j\,\mathrm dy_j$. In particular $\Omega_{C/A}\cong M\otimes_AC$ as $C$-modules, by the isomorphism sending $\mathrm d(\iota_M(x))$ to $x\otimes1$ for $x\in M$ ($\Omega$ as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]).
